title: Giving your words a clear continuation
meaning: You can turn a lively exchange of ideas into an understandable promise and enjoy the feeling that conversation is taking you somewhere.
text: An enthusiastic conversation can feel especially satisfying when it leaves you clear about what you have promised each other. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha helps suggestions develop: one thought invites a continuation, and a request meets several possible answers. The Emperor in energy supports a wish to give words a dependable form and take responsibility for what is said. The Chariot in emotions brings a feeling of progress. As the exchange finds direction, you can feel involved in something shared, with warmth taking on clear outlines.

Imagine discussing how to welcome guests. Favourite dishes and amusing stories gradually lead to decisions about who will call, what you will offer and when to confirm the time. **A promise grows stronger when an idea receives a continuation.** You can enjoy the conversation itself and still finish with an understandable sentence. Later, it lets you return to pleasant details without first having to establish what each person agreed to.

The difficulty appears if pleasure in finding a direction hurries agreement. It may seem that only details remain, although one still raises a doubt. A developing idea starts to sound like an approved plan before both people are ready to stand behind it. A brief clarification keeps the promise shared and leaves a suggestion free to change.
